bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/lab.rs (loudness only, app-private); springboard/src/media/symfile.rs and mp3.rs (file decode); springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (playback and capture service)
summary: The framework is audio analysis: a session that runs rhythm, key, loudness, pace, structure and instrument-activity analyses over a file or a buffer stream. BifrOSt has no analysis API. Only integrated loudness and true peak exist, as private DAW lab code, and there is no SDK surface for any of the six analyses.

features.note: no session object or analysis entry point in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/ui/src/

gaps: No audio analysis API in the SDK: no session, no analyze call, no result types for any of the six analyses.
Beat, bar and BPM detection on audio (RhythmResult). Only the project's stored tempo exists.
Structure segmentation (sections, segments, phrases) and pace analysis.
Instrument activity detection and source separation.
Loudness exists only as private DAW lab code: no momentary or short-term values, no streaming results, no SDK surface.
No buffer-stream input for analysis; decoders only return whole files to the DAW.
